programme.desc: Hired to defend an innocent newscaster, Matlock is baffled until evidence turns up that puts him on the trail of the real killer.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Things quickly descend from bad to worse for the Autobots when Detroit is menaced by new threats. Meanwhile, Ratchet remembers his first encounter with Omega Supreme and grows frustrated with his uselessness to the Autobots.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: The Autobots are given a triple blow when one of their own is critically damaged, another is overloading destructively and the third has become an assault weapon for Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Bulkhead must face off against the Constructicons and their new leader, Dirt Boss, when they decide to hold the city's oil supply hostage. Meanwhile, the other Autobots manage to capture Lugnut, but find hauling him away a more difficult task.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Unaware that he is being followed by the Elite Guard, Wasp heads to Earth to take his revenge on Bumblebee.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: When Sentinel Prime successfully captures fugitive Decepticons, Prowl becomes suspicious.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: The Autobots and the Elite Guard pursue Wasp for their own agenda. However, Blackarachnia has Swoop capture Wasp in her latest attempt to rid herself of her organic half. This experiment goes awry and turns Wasp into Waspinator.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, Optimus Prime patrols the city in search of Soundwave. With Porter C. Powell selling Soundwave action figures, Optimus is paranoid that the real Soundwave is out there.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: It turns out that Soundwave has trapped the Autobots in a virtual reality. Now, Sari must free them before Soundwave completely turns them into Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: In an effort to speed up their return to Cybertron, Sentinel Prime has Jazz pilot the Elite Guard ship through a space storm. The storm's energies reactivate Swindle, who frees his fellow Decepticon prisoners, and the group goes on to take over the ship.
programme.sub-title: This Is Why I Hate Machines

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: A TransWarp accident with the Space Bridge sends Ratchet and Captain Fanzone to Cybertron, where Sentinel Prime has the planet on high alert. They soon end up stumbling upon a plot by Shockwave to steal Omega Supreme's Access Codes from Arcee.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: The Autobots discover Omega Supreme's energy signal on the Moon. Rachet insists on going there right away to save him, but Prime refuses, knowing that they are too weak to fight Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: During the war on Cybertron, the Mini-Cons, mini-transformers who can be used as upgrades by their bigger brethren, crash lands on Earth. In present day, a group of children finds their ship by accident which brings the war to Earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Escaping from the confrontation between Bots and Cons, Alex, Rad and Carlos find the cargo hold of the Exodus underground and are adopted by three minicons. Retreating to the moon, the 'Cons make the wreck of the Exodus there their base.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Alexis, Rad and Carlos introduce themselves to Optimus Prime, Hot Rod and First Aid, and get a condensed history of the conflict. Meanwhile, on the moon, Megatron plots to capture the minicons that are now appearing all over earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The children join the Autobot team and head out on their first mission to find a newly waking minicon. The Decepticons arrive to combat them. Optimus Prime finds his old minicon partner.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The next minicon alert is from Antarctica. Starscream retrieves the minicon, but has it stolen from him. Hot Shot learns a lesson in cooperation.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The newest minicon activates in the middle of a forest: both sides fight for it, and the conflict sets the trees alight. The Autobots attempt to battle the blaze, while Starscream finally acquires his own minicon.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Rad and Carlos smuggle their minicons out of the base to visit the town's carnival. Billy and Fred see them transform and try to capture one, but are thwarted by Hot Shot.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: In an ancient palace deep beneath the Sahara another minicon is waking, but who will reach it first - the children or the Decepticon Demolishor?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the loss of the Star Sabre, the Autobots keep losing battles. In a fog-bound valley, Megatron plots to get the Sabre from Starscream, at the same time boosting his crew's confidence in himself. Scavenger's secret is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Autobots and Decepticons face off amongst snowy mountains in the battle for the latest minicon. Despite using the Star Sabre, this time Megatron loses - and Scavenger finally gains the Autobots' trust.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A weekend's camping trip to the valley below the dam goes wrong when a violent storm moves in. With Red Alert trapped in a mudslide, the sluice gates about to open, and local reporter Kelly filming, how will the Autobots escape detection?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player. The Decepticons acquire the final minicon to create the Skyboom Shield, the most powerful defensive weapon in the universe.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Confident of his ability to finally overcome the Autobots, Megatron challenges Optimus to battle. However, when all seems lost Optimus' minicon summons the Skyboom Shield to protect his master.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron's plan to split up the Autobot team and defeat them individually fails when it's revealed that the minicons have their own, secret agenda.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Decepticons lose another battle: Megatron takes out his frustration on Starscream, beating him half to death for no reason. Sideways uses the situation to try to foment unrest and rebellion.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Trapped in cyberspace with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity, far more powerful and dangerous than Megatron, lurking threateningly in the background. Or was it all a dream?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new transformer enters the solar system. On the moon, Thrust the master tactician arrives to assist Megatron in his battle against the Autobots, but all does not go according to plan.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command - and seriously underestimates the Decepticons. But on the verge of defeat, Optimus reveals a new ability.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron. On earth, despite Jetfire saying he's one of the good guys, the kids are suspicious of Sideways - as are the Decepticons. And something huge and ominous is approaching earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. No one but Jolinar has ever escaped from hell, so Tok'ra technology is used to access Jolinar's memories from Carter's mind…but not before an old foe shows up to foil the mission!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories…but how much can they take?

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Waking up in a psychiatric hospital outside of D.C., Weir is shocked to discover that her entire experience in Atlantis over the last two years was all in her imagination. She learns that a car accident left her suffering from delusional psychosis.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Summoned to a planet by a communication code, the team is ambushed by Kolya, who has now created his own faction of Genii after being forced from the inner circle. While the rest of the team manages to escape, Sheppard is taken prisoner.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: McKay is called back to earth to convince his estranged sister, Jeannie Miller, to assist the Air Force. McKay and Jeannie travel to Atlantis, and begin the experiment which is initially successful, until a McKay from the parallel universe appears.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Major Leonard's team fails to check in with Atlantis while on a mission. Following the energy readings in hope of finding Major Leonard and his men, McKay leads the team into a cave to discover that the cause the energy spike is a Wraith generator.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: The now awakened Ancients meet with O'Neill and Woolsey, thanking them for taking care of the city but also asking them to vacate Atlantis. While Ronon and Teyla stay in the Pegasus galaxy, the rest struggle to resume their lives on Earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 lands in the middle of a blazing battle between some Stargate soldiers and a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, O'Neill and the others provide assistance… until the mystery team turns its weapons on SG-1!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia. The planet's leader, a woman named Ke'ra, returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure. But as Ke'ra and Daniel develop a mutual attraction, SG-1 suspects she may not be who she appears to be.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. No one but Jolinar has ever escaped from hell, so Tok'ra technology is used to access Jolinar's memories from Carter's mind…but not before an old foe shows up to foil the mission!

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Major Leonard's team fails to check in with Atlantis while on a mission. Following the energy readings in hope of finding Major Leonard and his men, McKay leads the team into a cave to discover that the cause the energy spike is a Wraith generator.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: The now awakened Ancients meet with O'Neill and Woolsey, thanking them for taking care of the city but also asking them to vacate Atlantis. While Ronon and Teyla stay in the Pegasus galaxy, the rest struggle to resume their lives on Earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During routine medical exams, Dr. Fraiser injects each team member with a sedative. Teal'c awakens and sees General Hammond conspiring with Fraiser and two aliens. What has happened at Stargate Command, and can SG-1 overpower its own allies?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 is invited to planet Tollan to attend a Triad ceremony, they are shocked to discover it is actually a trial to determine the fate of their friend Skaara. Daniel and O'Neill must argue a case against a mysterious Goa'uld to save Skaara.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: En route to a planet, the SG-1 are implanted with an alien spore that evolves into a being called Urgo. Though Urgo claims to be friendly, the suspicious team members work feverishly to rid themselves of the creature before it destroys their minds.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 visits the friendly planet Edora and gathers to watch the annual meteor shower that lights up the sky like a fiery rain. But suddenly, wayward asteroids bombard the planet, destroying the Stargate. Can O'Neill and the team ever return home?

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in den Körper von Samuel Beederman, um das Schicksal von Tibby positiv zu beeinflussen. Samuel und Tibby sind in einer Nervenheilanstalt in Behandlung. Sam bringt Tibby das Lesen bei.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Dieses Mal tauschen Sam und Albert die Rollen und Sam bleibt als Observer in der Gegenwart. Albert reist ins Jahr 1945, wo er soeben als Kriegsveteran Tom in seinen Heimatort zurückgekehrt ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1961 und nimmt die Gestalt des Baseballspielers "Doc" Fuller an. Er soll seinen frühzeitigen Tod verhindern und seine Karriere vorantreiben. Fuller hat damals bei einem Unfall einen anderen Spieler umgebracht.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: In der Gestalt von Archie muss Sam im Jahr 1969 Menschen in Jackson Port vor einem Hurrikan retten. Die Bewohner weigern sich allerdings, ihre Wohnungen zu verlassen und wollen stattdessen eine Hurrikan-Party feiern.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss als Starfigaro Frank Bianca das Leben des behinderten Sohnes seiner Freundin Laura retten. Der hat beim Einkaufen zufällig einen Mord beobachtet und soll nun umgebracht werden.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft in die Gestalt von Katie McBrian, die nach einem Date im Krankenhaus liegt. Sie wurde von Kevin Wentworth brutalst vergewaltigt. Zusammen mit der Anwältin Nancy Hudson will Sam, alias Katie, nun einen Haftbefehl gegen Kevin erwirken.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss am 24. Januar 1961 in die Gestalt des Schimpansen Bobo schlüpfen. Die Schimpansen werden zu dieser Zeit oft als Versuchstiere für Tests benutzt, die meist tödlich enden. Sam versucht, diese Tierversuche zu stoppen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Janice DeCaro wurde auf brutale Art und Weise in ihrem eigenen Haus ermordet. Ihr wurde der Bauch aufgeschlitzt und das Herz herausgerissen. Unter den Hauptverdächtigen ist ihr Mann Peter, den die Polizisten mit einer Waffe in der Hand antreffen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1956 und schlüpft in den Körper des Scheckbetrügers Chance Cole. Er sitzt neun Monate im Gefängnis und freundet sich dort mit Jasper Boone an. Es stellt sich heraus, dass Boone unschuldig im Gefängnis sitzt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss sowohl die Karriere als auch das Glück von Jane Lindhurst und Joe Thurlow retten. Dafür reist er in das Jahr 1969 und schlüpft in den Körper des 25-Jährigen. Janes Sohn Neil und seine Frau wollen, dass sie wieder zurück nach Cleveland kommt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Philip Ashcroft lebt im Jahr 1964, lebt offen schwul und will eine militärische Karriere anstreben. Die wird jedoch durch eine Gruppe Jugendlicher unterbrochen, die Homosexuelle verprügeln.
programme.sub-title: Ein Kampf auf Leben und Tod

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1985 zurück und nimmt die Gestalt des Journalisten Dylan Powell an. Zusammen mit seinem Partner Ross Tyler produziert er ein Magazin, das allerdings kaum noch Auflagen hat.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam schlüpft im Jahr 1957 in den Körper der lebenden Legende Tyler Means. Er soll verhindern, dass Tyler bei einem Duell mit dem Cowboy Pat Knight getötet wird. Means wurde berühmt, da er die Stadt Coffin von der Claggett-Bande befreit hat.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam macht einen Zeitsprung zurück ins Jahr 1963, wo er in den Körper der Sängerin Cheree schlüpft. Er muss seine Bandkollegin Lynell davor bewahren, dass sie einen Vertrag mit dem Clubbesitzer und Zuhälter Bobby Lee unterschreibt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam muss als Co-Pilot eines Privatflugzeugs versuchen, das Leben eines der Passagiere zu retten. Grant und Michelle Cutter befinden sich an Bord der Maschine, als über dem Bermuda-Dreieck plötzlich der Kompass des Flugzeugs ausfällt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam ist in das Jahr 1958 gereist und ist nun im Körper des Taxifahrers Max Greenman. Kurz zuvor hat er bei einem Unfall eine Frau überfahren, die allerdings überlebt hat. Es stellt sich heraus, dass es sich um seinen Schutzengel handelt.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam ist in das Jahr 1985 gereist und befindet sich im Körper des berühmten Fernsehdoktors Lyle Hart. Norma Jean Pilcher ist unsterblich in ihn verliebt und hat bei einem Preisausschreiben ein Treffen mit ihm gewonnen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam erforscht im Körper des Professors Dale Conway das Grab des ägyptischen Pharaos Ptah-Hotep. Conway und seine Kollegin Ginny Will sind damals nie von ihrer Expedition zurückgekehrt. Sam soll ihre Mission nun erfolgreich zu Ende führen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1959 und schlüpft in den Körper des Sängers Davey Parker. Gemeinsam mit seinem Partner Mack MacKay gibt er ein Konzert, doch die beiden werden gefeuert. Die beiden werden zu Auftritten nach Las Vegas eingeladen.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick e o seu grupo fazem uma viagem arriscada para Washington DC em busca de artefatos que precisarão para construir a civilização que ele e Carl sonharam.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: As comunidades unem forças para reformar uma ponte que facilitará o comércio e a comunicação entre elas. Mas alguém se encontra gravemente ferido no canteiro de obras.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Os planos de Rick são ameaçados por um misterioso desaparecimento, que divide o campo de trabalho onde as comunidades estão erguendo uma ponte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A esperança de Rick de um futuro civilizado é ameaçada por uma súbita avaliação dos pecados do passado, que continuam sem perdão nem solução.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Os sobreviventes ainda lidam com a horrível demonstração de poder dos sussuradores, respeitando relutantemente as novas fronteiras impostas e se preparando para uma batalha que pode ser inevitável.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Os sobreviventes encontram rostos desconhecidos fora da segurança das paredes da comunidade e precisam decidir se esse novo grupo pode ou não ser confiável.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol procura um velho amigo que vive sozinho em um deserto cheio de caminhantes; sobreviventes fazem uma perigosa viagem em busca de um novo lar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Durante uma missão de resgate de um companheiro desaparecido, o grupo se depara com uma perigosa horda de zumbis. Porém, o que os humanos encontram é uma ameaça surpreendente, a qual pode colocar todos em perigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: As comunidades pensavam que poderiam construir um futuro melhor separadamente, mas uma recente perda as reúne novamente; surge uma ameaça perturbadora e novos líderes aparecem; um prisioneiro fugitivo se lembra do seu passado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A ousada missão de resgate de Daryl obriga Alpha a libertar um grupo para recuperar o que lhe pertence, mesmo que o preço seja pago com sangue. Os planos do Reino de reunir as comunidades estão em risco.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A chegada de um forasteiro força Alexandria a mexer com feridas antigas. Segredos do passado são revelados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez em anos, as quatro comunidades se unem em uma comemoração durante a feira do Reino. Enquanto alguns pactos são renovados, outros negócios exigem um preço alto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Depois de uma terrível perda, as comunidades devem enfrentar uma nevasca feroz. Enquanto um grupo lida com um inimigo interno, o outro é forçado a tomar uma decisão de vida ou morte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: O grupo em Oceanside continua com o seu treinamento para um possível retorno dos sussurradores. A tensão aumenta à medida que os heróis tentam se apegar ao seu conceito de civilização.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: This classic series takes us to America's favorite small town, Mayberry. "The Andy Griffith Show" serves up wit and warmth as Sheriff Andy Taylor (Andy Griffith) and bumbling Deputy Barney Fife (Don Knotts) solve the town's misdeeds.

programme.desc: Alexis, Rad and Carlos introduce themselves to Optimus Prime, Hot Rod and First Aid, and get a condensed history of the conflict. Meanwhile, on the moon, Megatron plots to capture the minicons that are now appearing all over earth.

programme.desc: The next minicon alert is from Antarctica. Starscream retrieves the minicon, but has it stolen from him. Hot Shot learns a lesson in cooperation.

programme.desc: In an ancient palace deep beneath the Sahara another minicon is waking, but who will reach it first - the children or the Decepticon Demolishor?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: From an ancient submerged city a beautiful girl issues a warning about the devastating power - and danger - of three special, combining minicons. The Autobots already have two of them: now Megatron aims to capture the third.

programme.desc: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player. The Decepticons acquire the final minicon to create the Skyboom Shield, the most powerful defensive weapon in the universe.
